headline: Approved seven revised policies, including discrimination complaint procedures and Child Find.
summary: Superintendent Ray reported on a flu vaccine clinic, the cross-country program, and rising bus ridership. Members approved the August 26, 2026 minutes, a consent agenda of staff appointments and a transfer, and seven revised policies on second reading.
decisions: Approved the August 26, 2026 meeting minutes, passed unanimously.
Approved the consent agenda of staff appointments and a transfer, passed unanimously.
Approved seven revised policies on second reading, each motion passed unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion by Marie Potvin, seconded by Amy Clearwater, to approve the August 26, 2026 meeting minutes. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion by Marie Potvin, seconded by Amy Clearwater, to approve the consent agenda. Motion passed unanimously.
For each policy listed below, Marie Potvin moved approval and Amy Clearwater seconded. Each motion passed unanimously.
